name: EPIC 249915278
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 14.9 solar radii and 0.92 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 249915278 (K2 campaign 15): PARAM radius (solar radii) 14.875253 (16th-84th percentiles 14.212259-15.807429), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 249915278: GALAH DR3 effective temperature 4402.0825 +/- 91 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 249915278 (K2 campaign 15): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2357.109375 (16th-84th percentiles 2272.402344-2465.292969), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.39 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; GALAH measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,357 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.92 solar masses and 14.9 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,402 K at its surface.
